# Kapaat — Community Launch Checklist

## awesome-selfhosted Submission

Submit a PR to [awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted](https://github.com/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted)
adding the following line under the **Inventory Management** section (alphabetical by name):

```markdown
- [Kapaat](https://github.com/nomi25home/kapaat) - Self-hosted garage and storage bin inventory with QR labels, photo capture, tag filtering, CSV/XLSX export, and Google Sheets sync via n8n. ([Demo](https://bins.home.mihirfamily.com), [Source Code](https://github.com/nomi25home/kapaat)) `MIT` `Python/Docker`
```

### Pre-submission checklist
- [ ] Public GitHub repo with OSI-approved license (MIT ✓)
- [ ] Working demo URL or screenshots in README
- [ ] Docker image published to GHCR (`ghcr.io/nomi25home/kapaat`)
- [ ] README covers install, config, and a quick-start
- [ ] No sign-up required to self-host
- [ ] PR title format: `Add Kapaat`
- [ ] Entry placed alphabetically within the section
